remarks: The unit will be getting new carpet, paint, Luxury vinyl flooring in FR. Lovely sunny 4th floor unit (top floor) overlooks the courtyard. Enjoy the change of seasons from your private balcony,there is a cute bistro set that will stay.No grills allowed on balcony. Largest unit in the complex with a loft and office/storage room. This area is perfect for a home office or cozy den. The family room has soaring ceilings and access to the balcony. The primary bedroom has a full bath, balcony and there is a flat screen TV attached to the wall that will stay. On the other side of the unit you will find two bedrooms and a full bath. There is an exercise room and club house room on site. This unit is next to the club house. Garage parking for one car, there are ample open spaces for guest parking. Located minutes to the heart of downtown where you can enjoy shopping, restaurants, Mill River Park is across the street. This complex is in a walkable neighborhood...Dunkin' Donuts is across the street, Target and the library are a block away, great places to eat and everything that you need is nearby. No pets and no smoking in the unit. Tenants pays all utilities ,cable, internet,including water, sewer usage fee, condo association charges a move in and move out fee $350 each. Subject to an excellent credit check,(score 740+)background check, income verification. Tenant pays for renters insurance.Tenants to abide by condo rules. Furnished Photos are from when owner lived in the unit.
